title: BCC Ruling No. 10-01-1237 — standpipe alternative measures in manufacturing plant
code_edition: Ontario Building Code 2006, O. Reg. 350/06 (as cited)

facts.text: The case concerns a new one-storey, non-combustible Group F, Division 3 manufacturing plant described as about 5,300 m², with a fire alarm system and no sprinklers.
The applicant proposed compensating measures in place of the standpipe system required by Article 3.2.9.1., including additional extinguishers and fire-department monitoring.
The ruling text identifies a system of internal piping with 65 mm hose connections as a condition in its disposition.
